name: BUG-15595
description: An idle session times out and auto-redirects the user to login without any action (ADO 15595)
descriptionHtml: An idle session times out and auto-redirects the user to login without any action (ADO 15595)
statusMessage: BUG-15595: after the session times out while idle, the app must bring the user to the login page on its own. It is still showing authenticated content (https://test.xpreshon.unearth.ai/) with no redirect — the timeout is only detected on the next user action. expected [true] but found [false]
